title: Enforcement.
officialText:
The police commissioner shall enforce such orders or requirements when requested by the
commissioner and shall likewise enforce same at the request of the commissioner of citywide administrative services, housing
preservation and development, or other authorized agency, with respect to work performed by or under the direction of such
commissioner pursuant to the provisions of section 28-216.8.3.3.
